title: 第7章 终于吃了顿饭第8章 仙人消息
content_zh:
易长生没打算现在出去，他回到书房再进入到地下室，按了一下机关，把门关上，然后就爬到木箱子上面躺下。
两个木箱子挺大的，合在一起正好可以给小小的他当床睡。
今天他累坏了，再不睡觉，他觉得自己要凉，有什么想法还是等明天睡醒了再打算。
想了想，感觉地下室还有点凉，他还从木箱里找出一张薄皮盖在肚子上。
一闭上眼睛，易长生一秒入睡。
第二天醒来，睁开眼睛一片漆黑，易长生愣了一下，很好，还是在地下室里，没有穿回去。
胃里的饥饿感提醒他要吃食物了，他按了一下胃，缓了缓刚醒来的迷糊，就进入虚维之眼的视角。
昨晚他将虚维之眼放在了宅子里的大门上，这会可以观察一下外面看看。
外面已经天亮了，看地面上阳光的位置，应该还是在辰时。
易长生观察了一会，巷子里没见到有人经过，周围也有点安静。
他起身，摸索着上楼梯按下第二块石砖，轻轻侧身出去，走出书房，他便在整个宅院的四周查看了起来。
宅院的后面是个小树林，西侧也有一个宅院，西北角那边隐隐能看到一点城墙，东侧也是一个宅院，而南面院门对面还是个宅院。
他用虚维之眼分别放置到四周隔壁宅院的屋檐上，查看这些宅院里的情况。
可能是这个位置有点偏僻的原因，三家宅院里都没有人住，这对易长生来说是个非常好的事情。
查看完这些，他就到井边打了一小桶水，喝了半勺水止渴。
当看到木桶里自己的倒影，一脸脏兮兮，身上的衣服也很脏了。
他这个仿佛乞丐的样子跑出去拿钱买食物的话，有点问题。
想了想，易长生直接就将衣服脱下来，打了一桶水洗了一下身体，再把衣服给洗了一下，用力拧干，放在院子里晾晒。
现在是夏天太阳很大，估计用不了多久衣服就能干了。
他光着身子，回到书房下到地下室，打开装有包袱的箱子，细看一下那些衣服。

衣服太大了，他穿着不适合。
他将两个钱袋找了出来，数了一下铜钱，两个加一起约两百铜钱，银子的话，碎银约十两左右，除此之外还有两张一百两的银票。
易长生将所有的钱都装到一个钱袋里，另一个钱袋他数了三十枚铜钱和一两银子放进去。
他拿着钱袋离开地下室，等衣服干的期间，再次细看了一下宅院里其他房间里的东西。
昨晚他只查看了有没有人，屋里的东西他没有细看，他要看看有没有用得上的东西。
主屋另一边的耳房里应该是更衣沐浴的地方，除了架子和一个大的木桶外，没有别的东西了。
他出去继续查看东西厢房，这两间房里除了家具没有其他东西，倒是厨房里有不少的东西。
像木桶、大锅、篮子、石磨、锅碗瓢盆、干柴、小炉等等都有，就是没有食物。
不过厨房里的东西都还有用，他打水将几个锅碗瓢盆之类全洗干净，再把一个小炉加上一些干柴全都搬到地下室去。
易长生是打算在这里暂住一段时间的。
虽然他现在有钱了可以在城里租房子住，但他年龄太小了，状态也不好，他怕去找牙行租房时，会被牙人顺手拐走卖了。
content_en:
Yi Changsheng had no intention of going out now. He returned to the study and entered the basement. He pressed the button, closed the door, and then climbed onto the wooden box and lay down.
The two wooden boxes are quite large, and together they can be used as a bed for his little one.
He was exhausted today. If he didn't sleep, he would feel cold. If he had any ideas, he would wait until he woke up tomorrow.
After thinking about it, he felt that the basement was still a little cold, so he found a thin piece of leather from the wooden box and covered his stomach.
As soon as he closed his eyes, Yi Changsheng fell asleep in a second.
When he woke up the next day, his eyes were completely dark. Yi Changsheng was stunned for a moment. It was fine. He was still in the basement and had not put it back on.
The hunger in his stomach reminded him that he needed to eat food. He pressed his stomach to relieve the confusion of just waking up, and then entered the perspective of the Eye of Xuwei.
Last night, he placed the Eye of Xuwei on the door of the house so that he could take a look outside.
It's already dawn outside. Judging from the position of the sun on the ground, it should still be around Chen time.
Yi Changsheng observed for a while. He saw no one passing by in the alley, and the surroundings were a bit quiet.
He stood up, groped his way up the stairs and pressed the second stone brick. He gently stepped out and walked out of the study. He then looked around the entire house.
Behind the house is a small forest, there is also a house on the west side, a bit of city wall can be seen faintly in the northwest corner, there is also a house on the east side, and there is another house opposite the south gate.
He used his virtual eyes to place them on the eaves of the neighboring houses to check the conditions in these houses.
Perhaps because this location is a bit remote, no one lives in the three houses, which is a very good thing for Yi Changsheng.
After checking these, he went to the well to fetch a small bucket of water and drank half a spoonful of water to quench his thirst.
When I saw my reflection in the barrel, my face was dirty and my clothes were also dirty.
There would be something wrong if he ran out to get money to buy food like a beggar.
After thinking about it, Yi Changsheng took off his clothes directly, washed his body with a bucket of water, washed the clothes again, wrung them dry, and put them in the yard to dry.
It's summer and the sun is very strong, so it won't take long for the clothes to dry.
Naked, he returned to the study and went down to the basement, opened the box containing the baggage, and took a closer look at the clothes.
The clothes were too big for him.
He found two money bags and counted the copper coins. The two together were about two hundred copper coins. In terms of silver, the broken silver was about ten taels. In addition, there were two silver notes worth one hundred taels.
Yi Changsheng put all the money into a money bag, and in the other money bag he counted thirty copper coins and one tael of silver and put them in.
He took the money bag and left the basement. While waiting for the clothes to dry, he took a closer look at the things in other rooms in the house.
Last night he only checked to see if anyone was there. He didn't take a closer look at the things in the house. He wanted to see if there was anything useful.
The wing room on the other side of the main house should be a place for dressing and bathing. There is nothing else except shelves and a large wooden barrel.
He went out and continued to check the east and west rooms. There was nothing in these two rooms except furniture, but there was a lot of stuff in the kitchen.
There are barrels, cauldrons, baskets, stone mills, pots and pans, dry firewood, small stoves, etc., but there is no food.
However, everything in the kitchen was still useful. He fetched water and washed all the pots and pans, and then moved a small stove and some dry firewood to the basement.
Yi Changsheng planned to stay here temporarily for a while.
Although he is now rich and can rent a house in the city, he is too young and in poor condition. He is afraid that when he goes to rent a house in a dental shop, he will be abducted and sold by the dental gang.
